-- Normalize all customer emails (trim and lower case)
UPDATE customers SET email = lower(trim(email));

-- Find duplicate normalized emails and the id to keep
WITH dup_emails AS (
  SELECT lower(trim(email)) AS norm_email,
         min(id) AS keep_id
  FROM customers
  GROUP BY norm_email
  HAVING count(*) > 1
)
-- Update orders that belong to duplicate customers (excluding the kept one)
UPDATE orders
SET customer_id = dup_emails.keep_id
FROM dup_emails
WHERE orders.customer_id IN (
  SELECT c.id
  FROM customers c
  JOIN dup_emails ON lower(trim(c.email)) = dup_emails.norm_email
  WHERE c.id != dup_emails.keep_id
);

-- Delete the duplicate customer rows that are not the kept ones
DELETE FROM customers
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT c.id
  FROM customers c
  JOIN dup_emails ON lower(trim(c.email)) = dup_emails.norm_email
  WHERE c.id != dup_emails.keep_id
);
-- Reclaim space
VACUUM;
